3. Chapter on Pure Truth Suddhasaccavāra

Positive (Anuloma)

It is suffering. Is it truth? Yes. 20. They are truths. Are they suffering-truth? Suffering-truth is both truth and suffering-truth. The remaining are truths, but not sufferingtruth. It is origination. It is truth? Yes. ...pe ... It is cessation. Is it truth? Yes. ...pe ... It is Path, Is it truth? Yes. They are truths. Are they path-truth? Path-truth is both truth and path-truth. The remaining are truths but not path-truth.

Negative (Paccanīka)

It is suffering. Is it not truth? With the exception of suffering, the 21. remaining truths are not suffering, but truths. With the exception of suffering and truth, the remaining is neither suffering nor truths. They are truths. Are they not suffering-truth? Yes.
